description: Fix the Bedrock chat feature, which is broken at runtime because the three hard-coded default Claude model IDs are retired (end-of-life). FEAT-102 deploy succeeded but POST /chat for rookie/champion/ultimate returns HTTP 502 with 'This model version has reached the end of its life.' This is a REAL, fixable code issue (not purely environmental). Investigation this session confirmed the account has ACTIVE Claude inference profiles that invoke successfully in us-east-1. The three current model IDs require an INFERENCE PROFILE (on-demand invocation of the bare foundation-model IDs is not supported: ValidationException 'Invocation ... with on-demand throughput isn't supported. Retry with the ID or ARN of an inference profile'). Verified-working inference-profile IDs (invoke-model returned valid Anthropic Messages responses this session): haiku -> us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 ; sonnet -> us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0 ; opus -> us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-5-20251101-v1:0 . Update the default model IDs in BOTH packages/shared/src/bedrock-models.ts (BEDROCK_MODEL_IDS) and infra/lib/digital-monster-stack.ts (DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_IDS) to these inference-profile IDs, AND fix the chat Lambda IAM policy so it can invoke inference profiles (requires permission on BOTH the inference-profile ARN in the deploy region AND the underlying cross-region foundation-model ARNs). Then redeploy and verify chat returns a 200 Japanese reply at the rookie tier. Depends on FEAT-102 (deployed stack).
steps: Read packages/shared/src/bedrock-models.ts and infra/lib/digital-monster-stack.ts. Confirm the two model-ID maps are currently kept in sync (they are: both list the retired claude-3-5-haiku / claude-3-5-sonnet-v2 / claude-3-opus IDs).

Update BEDROCK_MODEL_IDS in packages/shared/src/bedrock-models.ts to: haiku='us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0', sonnet='us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0', opus='us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-5-20251101-v1:0'. Update the doc comment to note these are cross-region inference-profile IDs (the 'us.' prefix) and remain overridable via env vars. The existing shared unit test 'resolveModelId'/model-mapping tests assert the DEFAULT values - update those expected constants in packages/shared/src/__tests__/* to match the new IDs so the 42-test suite stays green and still pins the mapping.

Update DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_IDS in infra/lib/digital-monster-stack.ts to the same three inference-profile IDs, keeping it in sync with the shared map (there is a comment stating they must stay in sync).

Fix the chat Lambda IAM policy in digital-monster-stack.ts. Inference profiles require bedrock:InvokeModel on BOTH: (1) the inference-profile ARN arn:<partition>:bedrock:<region>:<account>:inference-profile/<id> for each of the three IDs, and (2) the underlying foundation-model ARNs. Because these are cross-region (us.) system-defined profiles that route to multiple regions, grant the foundation-model resource as arn:<partition>:bedrock:*::foundation-model/<bare-model-id-without-us-prefix> for each (strip the leading 'us.' to get the foundation-model id). Build both ARN sets from the model IDs and pass all of them as the PolicyStatement resources. Keep the policy scoped to ONLY the chat Lambda and ONLY bedrock:InvokeModel (do not widen to InvokeModelWithResponseStream unless needed; current handler uses InvokeModel). Note Aws.ACCOUNT_ID is available for the inference-profile ARN account segment.
Run npm run build (root) - must exit 0. Run npm test (root) - must be green with the updated expected model IDs.
cd infra && npx cdk deploy --all --require-approval never. Capture outputs (ApiUrl should be stable; CloudFront may be unchanged).

Verify chat end-to-end against the deployed ApiUrl: POST /chat with an UNSAVED monsterId and stageId='rookie' and a Japanese message; expect HTTP 200 with a non-empty Japanese reply and modelId echoing the haiku inference-profile ID. Record the exact response. Optionally also test champion (sonnet) and ultimate (opus). Confirm baby still returns the canned modelId='none' reply without calling Bedrock.

If chat now works, record success in findings. If a NEW environmental blocker appears (e.g. a different AccessDenied), capture exact error and record it. Commit all code changes on branch `fix/bedrock-model-ids` (one coherent commit covering shared + tests + infra). Do NOT push.
acceptance_criteria: BEDROCK_MODEL_IDS (shared) and DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_IDS (infra) both updated to the three verified ACTIVE inference-profile IDs and kept in sync
chat Lambda IAM policy grants bedrock:InvokeModel on both the inference-profile ARNs and the underlying foundation-model ARNs, still scoped to only the chat Lambda
npm run build exits 0 and npm test is green (expected model-ID constants in shared tests updated to match)

cdk deploy succeeds and POST /chat at the rookie tier returns HTTP 200 with a non-empty Japanese reply (recorded verbatim in findings); baby still returns canned modelId='none' without invoking Bedrock
Code committed on branch fix/bedrock-model-ids (not pushed)
